notes.title: Update: Camera Shake Removed
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update: Camera Shake Removed[/b]
Thanks to your feedback, we've removed the shaking camera effect from the [i]Into the Fold: Nala Junction[/i] demo. The camera is now more stable and less distracting during gameplay.[/p][p]We really appreciate the suggestions, this is just a demo, and your input is helping shape the final game. More improvements and updates are coming soon! [/p]
